description: Average per-host CPU I/O-wait percentage across the cluster over the time window, indicating time spent waiting on disk I/O rather than doing CPU work.
Sum of per-node CPU cgroup-throttling rate across the cluster over the time window; non-zero values indicate nodes are hitting their CPU resource limits.
Maximum CPU utilization across the nodes of the container cluster.
Average active threads as a percentage of pool size for the default-handler-common thread pool over the time window.
Average number of pending tasks queued for the default-handler-common thread pool over the time window.
Average queue fill percentage (size / capacity) for the default-handler-common thread pool over the time window.
Average OS-level disk utilization percentage across the cluster's nodes.
Average active threads as a percentage of pool size for the feedapi-handler thread pool over the time window.
Average number of pending tasks queued for the feedapi-handler thread pool over the time window.
Average queue fill percentage (size / capacity) for the feedapi-handler thread pool over the time window.
Maximum GPU memory utilization (used/total) across GPU-equipped nodes, averaged over the time window.
Maximum GPU utilization across container-cluster nodes with GPUs attached, averaged over the time window (only produces data for GPU-equipped nodes).
Average configured JVM direct (off-heap) memory capacity on container nodes.
Approximate percentage of CPU time spent in JVM garbage collection on container nodes, averaged over the time window.
Average stop-the-world JVM GC pause duration on container nodes over the time window.
Average configured JVM heap memory capacity (max heap size) on container nodes.
Average native (off-JVM) memory used by C++ libraries loaded via JNI (e.g. ONNX Runtime for embedders, linguistics) on container nodes.
Average OS-level memory utilization across the cluster's nodes (physical RAM usage), distinct from the Vespa-computed content memory-utilization metric.
Maximum memory utilization of the content cluster's cluster controller.
Average per-interval network bytes received by container nodes, summed across the cluster over the time window.
Minimum node-liveness value across all nodes in the cluster over the time window; drops to 0 if any node stops reporting a heartbeat.
Peak number of open HTTP server connections on container nodes observed during the time window.
Average number of HTTP requests served per connection over its lifetime on container nodes during the time window.
Average number of pending tasks queued for the search-handler thread pool over the time window.
Average queue fill percentage (size / capacity) for the search-handler thread pool over the time window.
